julian_sre: Preflight notice: quick KV cache maintenance scheduled Wed 2026-04-08 22:00-23:00 UTC. This is a low-risk purge + slot rebalance on a handful of edge racks.
julian_sre: Goal: evict stale prefixes >45d and redistribute hot slots to reduce eviction storms. Affects: eu-north-1 and us-west-1 edge racks.
infrabot: Event logged: 'kv-cache-preflight-2026-04-08' by julian_sre.
priya_oncall: Acknowledge. I'll be oncall and watch edge.kvcache.eviction_rate, infer.latency_p95 and route_error_pct.
nina_prod: Product: do we need support blurb if Dedicated tenants see >15% p95 increase for >20m?
julian_sre: Good call. Prep short notice and hold until we breach that threshold before sending.
chris_eng: I'll run a soft rewarm with 4 workers, 100 qps cap per-AZ, and random jitter 0-45s. Script: tools/soft_rewarm.sh --workers 4 --qps 100 --jitter 45.
priya_oncall: Rollback triggers: infer.p95 > baseline*1.15 for 10m or 5xx_rate +0.4% absolute -> immediate rollback. Rollback steps: POST /infra-api/route-shift {"policy":"kv-maint-hedge","percent":0} and kubectl scale cronjob kv-maint -n infra --replicas=0.
julian_sre: Also quick toggles: inference.max_concurrent_tokens and route.batch_size_override available via config; use if GPU mem climbs.
infrabot: Config scheduled: kv-maint@infra at 2026-04-08T22:00Z.
priya_oncall: I'll open a watch channel and post minute-by-minute status if anything notable.
julian_sre: Thanks — preflight checklist will be posted to confluence and I'll paste link here before the window. Ping me if you want to shadow the canary.
